background.value: neutral grey (light grey), plain, single-color, providing sufficient contrast to face and hair

head_height.value: 32-36mm from chin to crown (face occupies 70-80% of photo height)

file_spec.value: minimum 600 dpi resolution, high-quality photo paper; since May 1, 2025 digital submission via certified photo studio (Lichtbildübermittlungsstelle) required for ID documents

expression_restriction.value: neutral expression, mouth closed, no smiling, looking directly into camera

glasses_policy.value: not permitted; glasses banned in all German biometric ID photos since November 2017 per BMI Fotomustertafel

face_visibility.value: full face must be clearly visible and centered, eyes fully open, sharp and clear image with sufficient contrast, no shadows or reflections on face

headwear_policy.value: not permitted except for religious or medical reasons; face from lower chin edge to forehead must remain fully visible

size.evidence: Multiple independent sources confirm German passport photos are 35 x 45mm. The cited German Embassy Dublin page discusses face size (32-36mm chin to hairline) within this standard photo size. Independent confirmation from how-to-germany.com states 'a standardized image size of 35 mm x 45 mm' for German passport/visa photos. This is also the standard biometric Passbild size per Bundesdruckerei specifications. Numerous third-party photo services (passlens.com, passportphototools.com, visafoto.com) all consistently cite 35x45mm.
